title: Pierce-bomb power-up — blast walks through the first soft block without stopping
intent: First far-future power-up from `gameplay-systems.md §5.3`. Pierce makes a bomb's blast walk through the FIRST soft block in each direction without stopping (still destroying it). Subsequent soft blocks in the same direction stop the blast as normal — pierce is single-block, not infinite. Adds tactical depth: stack pierce + range = long block-clearing lines, threading enemies behind cover. Single-component schema change + a small branch in `BlastPropagationSystem`. Sets the pattern for future similar pickups (Bomb Pass, Block Pass) so dev knows the shape.
rationale: Source: `gameplay-systems.md §5.3 Pierce Bomb` (reserved naming `BomberStats.pierce: boolean`, `Bomb.pierce: boolean`, already in the design doc) + §3.5 (pierce rule deferred). User direction 2026-05-26: content variety. Pierce is the highest-impact single-mechanic addition because it changes the BLAST shape, not just stat values — fundamentally different tactical reads.
acceptanceHints: examples/kaboom-crew/schemas/scene-extensions.schema.json:
Pickup.kind enum gains `pierce`
BomberStats gains optional `pierce: boolean` (default false)
Bomb component gains optional `pierce: boolean` — CARRIED AT PLACEMENT TIME from owner's BomberStats (the owner can lose pierce after placing a pierce bomb; the bomb keeps its property)
examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/pickup-spawn-system.ts: `pierce` in the drop table at ~half the rarity of bomb-up.
examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/pickup-collect-system.ts: `pierce` branch sets BomberStats.pierce = true. Idempotent (already true = no-op).
examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/bomb-placement-system.ts: when spawning a Bomb entity, COPY BomberStats.pierce → Bomb.pierce.

examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/blast-propagation-system.ts: the propagation loop is the key change. Current: walk cells in each direction; stop at first hard block, destroy + stop at first soft block. Pierce: walk cells in each direction; stop at first hard block; destroy + CONTINUE on the first soft block; destroy + stop on the second soft block. Each direction tracks its own pierce-budget (1) independently.
Server-side parity (post-GDP-022-011 multiplayer Sprint B): the server's blast-propagation-system gets the same branch. Single source of truth for the pierce rule.

MULTIPLE BLOCKS EDGE CASE: pierce is ONE block per direction, not one block total. A pierce bomb at the centre of a + of soft blocks destroys 1 block per direction (4 blocks total), and the blast continues 1 more cell beyond each. Symmetric, deterministic.

CHAIN-REACTION EDGE: a pierce bomb's blast walking through soft blocks can chain-trigger another bomb on the other side. That bomb's pierce property is its own (not inherited from the triggering bomb's pierce).
PICKUP DESTRUCTION: pickups in the blast path are destroyed (same as today). Pierce doesn't change this.
HUD: bottom-left per-bomber line shows `P` flag when pierce is on (mirrors K/R/S flags from existing power-ups).
AUDIO: no new event; existing `blast` clip + voice-blast fire as usual. The visual difference (longer blast lane through cleared blocks) is the readability layer.
VFX: existing blast-burst particles emit at every cell the blast reaches, including the pierce-through cell. No new shader.

BOT AI: pierce-aware bot decision is OUT OF SCOPE for this story. Bot collects pierce pickup but doesn't strategically use it (same pattern as Kick / Remote — bot can collect but doesn't strategise around it). Pierce-aware bots are a follow-up if playtest shows the difference matters.
UNIT TESTS:
Pickup → BomberStats.pierce flips true.
Pierce bomber places → Bomb.pierce = true.
Non-pierce bomber places → Bomb.pierce = false / undefined.
Blast through soft block: 2 soft blocks in a row, pierce blast → first destroyed AND second destroyed; non-pierce blast → first destroyed, second untouched.
Blast through hard block: hard blocks ALWAYS stop the blast, pierce or not.
Blast through 3 soft blocks in a row, pierce: first + second destroyed (pierce allows 1 extra past first), third untouched.
Multi-direction independence: pierce blast at + of 3 soft blocks each direction → 2 destroyed each direction (4 directions × 2 = 8 blocks total).
Range interaction: range=2 + pierce → walks 2 cells with 1 extra-past-soft-block credit; the extra cell counts toward range.

DETERMINISM: pierce decision is deterministic per cell visit. Bot-vs-bot regression test must continue to resolve within budget when one bot has pierce; potentially faster (more block-clearing → more pickups).
OUT OF SCOPE:
Pierce that walks through MULTIPLE soft blocks (infinite-pierce). 1-block-pierce keeps the readability — players can predict where pierce stops.
Pierce + Kick combination (kicked pierce bomb keeps its pierce property — that's implicit from the carried-at-placement rule).
Pierce-aware bot AI.
